description.content:
REST API for managing asset types, variable definitions, assets, and their
associations. Intended as a machine-readable contract for generating
client applications and CRUD interfaces.

Updates use PATCH with partial request bodies; the service does not expose
PUT operations. Collection endpoints return arrays and currently do not
support pagination, filtering, or sorting. There is no authentication
scheme configured in this service.

The asset hierarchy is also available over gRPC on port 50051, but gRPC
methods are not represented in this OpenAPI document.
